summary: First iteration testing of EtOH (AI Commercial Director for wines & spirits). BACKEND: 22/22 pytest tests passing (100%) covering signup, login, /auth/me, profile update, home recommendations (AI 3 actions), coach multi-turn chat + sessions list, studio generate (linkedin/premium), studio history, pilot plan (5 targets + 4 tasks), pilot history, logout, _id exclusion, 401 unauth checks. FRONTEND (Expo web preview, 420x900 mobile viewport): full end-to-end happy path validated — login screen renders, password login works, Home shows greeting + 3 module tiles + 3 AI recommendations with module color borders, Coach tab sends a message and receives a structured Markdown reply (~10s), Studio LinkedIn premium template generates content with Copy/Share, Pilot returns 5 target cards + 4 task rows, Profile fields editable + logout returns to login screen, all 5 bottom tabs navigate correctly. No mocked APIs — all AI calls hit real OpenAI gpt-4o-mini via Emergent Universal Key. No deprecated expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). One minor RN-web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (originates from RN/Expo internals, not app code).

minor.issue: Logout endpoint only deletes Google session tokens from user_sessions collection; JWT tokens remain valid until natural expiry (no blacklist). Acceptable for MVP but documented behavior should be confirmed.

integration_issues.issue: After logout, Home screen briefly fires POST /api/home/recommendations causing a 401 (visible in console). Likely a race — token cleared but home effect runs once more before unmount. Cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from RN web internals — monitor on next Expo SDK upgrade.

action_items: (Optional) Split server.py (~782 lines, just over 700-line guideline) into auth/coach/studio/pilot/home routers for maintainability.
(Optional) Guard the Home recommendations effect against running after sign-out to avoid 401 noise in logs.
(Optional) Decide whether JWT logout should be a real revocation (blacklist or short-lived + refresh) for production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py monolithic at 782 lines (slightly above 700-line guideline); split into routers/services for future scale.

Coach endpoint replays last user message via send_message inside a `for` loop with an immediate `break` (dead code lines 509-516) — already bypassed by the simpler concat-history path below it; safe to delete.
All MongoDB reads correctly use {'_id': 0} projection — no ObjectId leakage observed.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and JWT_SECRET correctly loaded from .env, no hardcoded credentials in code.

rca_of_issue: Original concern in review_request: 'headless screenshots showed only loading state'. Root cause: the Expo web bundle takes 6-10s to bundle+hydrate on cold start (Metro builds 900 modules on first request). Solution applied in test: wait_for_selector with 30s timeout on '[data-testid="auth-tab-login"]' after navigation — login screen then appears reliably and full E2E flow completes. No code change needed; this is normal Expo web cold-start behavior. Recommend documenting expected cold-start latency, or pre-warming the bundle in CI.
